about: Which controls a level curve (0..1) drives, per library. Shared by web/features/library-profiles.js (page) and src/claude/scoreview/CurvePlayer.java (read from the jar at start-up: every vst3/remote target gets a Bitwig Parameter in init()). Target kinds: vst3 (plugin = VST3 class id from Bitwig's plug-in cache, param = VST3 parameter id), remote (index = remote control of the device's current page, 0-based), cc (MIDI CC sent to the track, experimental). role: dynamics = carries the shape; expression = the second slider of a dual-control library. value = min + (max - min) * level^gamma. See docs/features/library-profiles.md.

profiles.name: Spitfire (Kontakt, CC1 + CC11)
profiles.note: Sent to the track with Track.sendMidi: the plug-in follows it (probe), but Bitwig does not record it as automation, so Render only plays it.

profiles.name: Arturia Pigments
profiles.note: Macro 1 must be remote control 1 of the device's current remote-controls page in Bitwig (Pigments' VST3 macro id is not known yet; once probed, add a vst3 target).
